t: Is It Worth It To Buy 1 Share of a Stock?
s: June 28, 2022 - If you choose a method called “dollar-cost averaging,” you buy new shares at regular intervals, regardless of price. As your shares accumulate, the average price paid evens out. You don’t have to worry about volatility because you are taking advantage of market ups and downs through regular trades. That reduces your risk and builds your long–term wealth. Assuming you choose a reliable company, it is worth investing in one share of stock.
